notes: Melchi, an ancestor of Jesus mentioned in Luke's genealogy.

name: Melchizedek
meaning: King of Salem and priest of God Most High.
notes: Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of God Most High, who blessed Abraham.

name: Melea
meaning: An ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy.
notes: Melea, mentioned in Luke's genealogy of Jesus.

name: Melech
meaning: A descendant of King Saul.
notes: Melech, a descendant of King Saul mentioned in the genealogies of Benjamin.

name: Melzar
meaning: Babylonian official in charge of Daniel and his friends.
notes: Melzar, the steward appointed by the chief eunuch to oversee Daniel and his companions.

name: Memucan
meaning: One of the seven princes of Persia and Media.
notes: Memucan, a wise prince who advised King Ahasuerus to depose Queen Vashti.

name: Menahem
meaning: King of Israel who reigned for ten years.
notes: Menahem, king of Israel, known for his cruelty and for paying tribute to Assyria.

name: Menna
meaning: An ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy.
notes: Menna, mentioned in Luke's genealogy of Jesus.

name: Menuhoth
meaning: A clan descended from Caleb.
notes: Menuhoth, a clan descended from Caleb, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

name: Meonothai
meaning: Son of Othniel and father of Ophrah.
notes: Meonothai, son of Othniel, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

name: Mephibosheth
meaning: Son of Saul and Rizpah, given to the Gibeonites.
notes: Mephibosheth, son of Saul and Rizpah, was given to the Gibeonites for execution.

name: Mephibosheth
meaning: Son of Jonathan and grandson of King Saul.
notes: Mephibosheth, also called Merib-baal, was the son of Jonathan and grandson of King Saul.

name: Merab
meaning: Eldest daughter of King Saul.
notes: Merab, the eldest daughter of King Saul, was promised to David but given to Adriel.

name: Meraiah
meaning: A priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim.
notes: Meraiah, a priest who served during the time of Joiakim the high priest.

name: Meraioth
meaning: A priest in the lineage of Eleazar.
notes: Meraioth, a priest in the lineage of Eleazar, mentioned in genealogies.

name: Merari
meaning: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.
notes: Merari, the third son of Levi, was the founder of the Merarite clan of Levites.

name: Mered
meaning: Son of Ezrah from the tribe of Judah.
notes: Mered, a son of Ezrah, married Bithiah, the daughter of Pharaoh.

name: Meremoth
meaning: An Israelite who married a foreign woman.
notes: Meremoth, an Israelite who married a foreign woman during the Babylonian exile.

name: Meremoth
meaning: A priest who returned from the Babylonian exile.
notes: Meremoth, a priest who returned from the Babylonian exile and was involved in the rebuilding of Jerusalem.

name: Meres
meaning: One of the seven princes of Persia and Media.
notes: Meres, one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who advised King Ahasuerus.

name: Merodach-baladan
meaning: King of Babylon who sent envoys to Hezekiah.
notes: Merodach-baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah, king of Judah.

name: Mesha
meaning: Son of Caleb and founder of Ziph.
notes: Mesha, a son of Caleb, was the father (ie founder) of Ziph.

name: Mesha
meaning: A descendant of Benjamin born in Moab.
notes: Mesha, a descendant of Benjamin, was born to Shaharaim in the country of Moab.

name: Mesha
meaning: King of Moab who rebelled against Israel.
notes: Mesha, king of Moab, rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

name: Meshech
meaning: Son of Japheth and grandson of Noah.
notes: Meshech, a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah, is mentioned in the Table of Nations.

name: Meshelemiah
meaning: A Levite gatekeeper in the time of David.
notes: Meshelemiah (also called Shelemiah), a Levite gatekeeper during David's reign.

name: Meshezabel
meaning: A leader who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
notes: Meshezabel, one of the leaders who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.

name: Meshezabel
meaning: A representative of the people to the Persian king.
notes: Meshezabel, from the descendants of Judah, was the people's representative to the Persian king.

name: Meshezabel
meaning: One who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem.
notes: Meshezabel, son of Berechiah, helped repair the wall of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

name: Meshillemith
meaning: A priest who settled in Jerusalem after the exile.
notes: Meshillemith (also called Meshillemoth), a priest who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.
